items.title: Black Panther
items.line: It opened February 16 and passed $1.3 billion worldwide. Ryan Coogler's film became the first superhero movie nominated for Best Picture.

items.title: Avengers: Infinity War
items.line: It opened April 27 and finished around $2.05 billion worldwide. Anthony and Joe Russo directed it.

items.title: Tham Luang cave rescue
items.line: Twelve boys and their coach were trapped in a Thai cave from June 23. Divers found them alive on July 2, and the last of them came out on July 10.

items.title: 2018 World Cup
items.line: Russia hosted from June 14 to July 15. France beat Croatia 4-2 in the final at Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow.

items.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
items.line: It came out October 26 and took over $725 million in its first three days. Roger Clark won a Game Award for playing Arthur Morgan.

items.title: Into the Spider-Verse
items.line: It arrived December 14, drawn to look like a moving comic page, halftone dots included. It won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
